Resolves #19335

`AGENTS_STARTUP.md` leaves the engine. The operator deprecated its boot workflow on 2026-06-04 and asked for the file's removal on 2026-09-30.

- The AI Quick Start's first session loses the step that scripted the file, and its troubleshooting line.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s first step for outside agents becomes the contributor guidance, in the wording agreed on #18985 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18985#issuecomment-5930572298)): `npx -p neo-agent-skills neo-agent-skills-agents-md --repo neo --audience contributor`. `-p` names our package, so npx never resolves the unclaimed bin name from the registry.

Both prerequisites have merged: neomjs/neo-agent-brain#647 took the file out of the resume prompt, and neomjs/neo-agent-skills#131 out of the skills.

Evidence: L1 (the deletion, a grep with a must-match control, and the new command run with and without an install) → L1 required (no AC needs a running agent). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `AGENTS_STARTUP.md` is deleted (188 lines). `git grep AGENTS_STARTUP -- CONTRIBUTING.md .github/AI_QUICK_START.md` finds nothing, while `neo-agent-skills-agents-md` still matches in `CONTRIBUTING.md`. |
| AC-2 | `4c31ab7` carries the wording agreed on #18985, with "you need" for "your agent needs", because that list addresses the agent itself. |

## Deltas from ticket

- **The blog's reference link is pinned** to `83e0c2f`, the last commit that carries the file, so `context-engineering-done-right.md` keeps a working link. Its text stays, as the ticket says.
- **The engine's skills stay at 0.1.19 here.** Their five mentions of the file are review-checklist prompts and descriptions; none tells a session to read it. 0.1.24 has none, and `.github/dependabot.yml` keeps a skills bump in a PR of its own.

## Test Evidence

- `npx -p neo-agent-skills neo-agent-skills-agents-md --repo neo --audience contributor` exits 0 on a seat checkout (the installed 0.1.19, 7,304 B) and in an empty directory (npx installs 0.1.24: 7,401 B, no mention of the file).
- The mentions left are history: release notes v11.18.0 and v12.0.0, the two blog posts, the dated cognitive-load baseline and the portal archives.

## Post-Merge Validation

None: both ACs are verified at this head.

## Commits

- `d7d1c96` the file leaves, the quick start stops scripting it, and the blog link is pinned
- `3a96155` CONTRIBUTING's first step for outside agents
- `4c31ab7` #18985's two amendments: `-p neo-agent-skills`, and "nothing private"
